notes: The big header pill is gone. Ask SideCut is now a small round overlay button in the top right of the listening-stats card, right before the resize chip - the same size as the bubble controls it sits with.
The tap belongs to the button, not the card: pressing it opens the drawer and leaves the stats panel closed.
It carries the sparkle and nothing else, so it stays a thumb-sized target instead of a second header.
Everything the drawer learned in 75.0 is unchanged: one sentence still plans an album, Do it still makes it, and Undo still takes it back exactly.
The multi-select bar keeps its own Ask button, exactly as it was.
The header is back to the three buttons it has always had: notifications, sync and Settings.
